<cite ref="Kiddushin 81a:13">Kidd. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>אידמי ליה ש׳ כאיתתא</he> Satan (temptation) appeared to him as a woman.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 81a:15">Ib.</cite> <he>הוה רגיל … גירא בעיניה דש׳</he> used to say every day, I challenge Satan, v. <cite ref="C00806"><he>גִּיר</he> III</cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 32a:7">Sabb. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ בתרי אומי וכ׳</he> Satan has no power over two persons of different nationalities (on the same boat &c.); a. e.—V. <cite ref="O00499"><he>סְטַן</he> II</cite>.—Pl. <he>שִׂטְנֵי</he>, <he>שׂוֹטְנֵי</he>, v. <cite ref="O00499"><he>סְטַן</he> II</cite>.
